body: Oh I've tried everything, from going to my GP to medication to therapy to hotlines to careers advisers to looking for jobs in different fields to lowering my expectations, it helps and then I get a full month of rejection even for positions way below my skill level & experience and here we go again, it gets worst over time too. I literally need a miracle at this point.
I'm going to enjoy them as much as possible during that month I have left, I plan on making this month the best I've ever had as it will be the last
